subject: general
question: In June 2025, who has been re-appointed as the new CBDT Chairman?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Agarwal**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Ravi Agarwal** has been re-appointed as the **Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) in June 2025**. The CBDT is the apex body of the Income Tax Department in India. 
• The **CBDT Chairman** plays a critical role in formulating policies, overseeing tax administration, and ensuring compliance with tax laws in India. 
• **Ravi Agarwal** has previously served in several senior roles within the Income Tax Department, showcasing his expertise in tax administration and policy implementation. 
• The appointment of the CBDT Chairman is typically carried out by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)**, which is headed by the Prime Minister of India. 
• This re-appointment reflects the government's confidence in **Ravi Agarwal's leadership** and his ability to steer the Income Tax Department effectively. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT):** 
• The CBDT is a statutory authority functioning under the **Department of Revenue**, Ministry of Finance, Government of India. 
• It is responsible for administering direct tax laws, including the **Income Tax Act, 1961**, and the **Wealth Tax Act, 1957** (now abolished). 
• The CBDT consists of a Chairman and six members, each of whom handles specific functions such as legislation, investigation, and taxpayer services. 
• **Responsibilities of the CBDT Chairman:** 
• Overseeing the administration of direct tax laws and ensuring **compliance with tax regulations**. 
• Formulating policies to improve tax collection and reduce tax evasion. 
• Supervising the functioning of the Income Tax Department across India. 
• Providing inputs for the annual Union Budget, particularly in matters related to taxation policies. 
• **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC):** 
• The ACC is responsible for appointments to the top posts in the government, including secretaries, additional secretaries, and directors of various departments. 
• It is chaired by the **Prime Minister**, with the **Home Minister** as a member. 
• The ACC ensures that appointments are made based on merit, experience, and the requirements of the respective departments. 
• **Recent Initiatives by CBDT:** 
• Introduction of the **Faceless Assessment Scheme** to enhance transparency and efficiency in tax administration. 
• Implementation of the **Taxpayer Charter** to ensure accountability and safeguard taxpayer rights. 
• Promotion of e-filing and digital platforms to simplify tax compliance for individuals and businesses. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **CBDT's Role in Economic Policy:** 
• The CBDT plays a pivotal role in shaping India's **tax policies** and ensuring their alignment with the nation's economic goals. 
• It works closely with other government departments to facilitate **ease of doing business** and attract foreign investments. 
• **Notable Predecessors:** 
• Several former CBDT Chairpersons have contributed significantly to modernizing India's tax system, including the introduction of GST and digital tax platforms. </ul
